result.title: Autoencoder Based Deep Clustering of Point Clouds
result.summary: Motivated by a problem in Generative Specification-Producing AIs (SPAIs), we focus on a problem of deep clustering of three-dimensional shapes specified by point clouds. After reviewing clustering and deep clustering, we study the fully unsupervised pipeline in which a FoldingNet autoencoder is first trained for reconstruction and then K-means++ is then applied to the resulting codewords. We report clustering accuracy (ACC), normalized mutual information (NMI) and adjusted Rand index (ARI) on ModelNet10 and ModelNet40 datasets, as a function of the number of clusters K. We also provide t-SNE visualizations of the codewords, and discuss the choice of K.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究三维点云形状的全无监督深度聚类：先训练 FoldingNet 自编码器做重建，再对得到的 codeword 施加 K-means++，在 ModelNet10/40 上按聚类数 K 报告 ACC、NMI、ARI，并给出 codeword 的 t-SNE 可视化与 K 的选取讨论。
